headings.rules: Avoid default bold. Use tracking-tight for large headings. Never center default. Apply for H1-H4.

body.rules: Use leading-relaxed. Left align for readability. Use for paragraphs, forms, and tables.

mono.rules: Use for invoice numbers, photo IDs, timestamps, and financial figures.

colors.strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic Earthy. The UI acts as a neutral frame to let the photography pop. Chrome-as-content pattern.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat borders (1px) over shadows. If using shadow, use soft diffuse (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]).
visual_enhancers.borders: Visible grid skeleton. Cardless design or 1px subtle borders (border-border).
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness, max 4px or 8px (rounded-sm or rounded-md). Not fully rounded.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain on backgrounds to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers. backdrop-blur-xl with border-b. Ensure high opacity (bg-background/80) so text remains readable.

layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar (220px fixed) + Content area. High density grid (gap-6). Widget metrics in col-span-1, Charts in col-span-2 or 3. Cardless style. Strict hierarchy.
layouts.client_portal: Generous spacing. Masonry gallery for photo selection (columns-1 md:columns-3 lg:columns-4). Clean invoice view.
layouts.public_booking: Bento Grid strategy (Tetris Mode) for packages. Asymmetric layout.
layouts.calendar: Full width interactive calendar with status badges indicating conflict (Bentrok) or open.

components.navigation: Fixed left sidebar for Admin with active state highlighting. Sticky header with crystal glass for Client Portal.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border. No drop shadows. High contrast text.
components.buttons: Sharp (rounded-sm), high contrast hover states. Primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90.
components.photo_gallery: Masonry feed. Images have no borders until selected. Selected photos have a 2px primary border and a checkmark overlay.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Inputs, Checkboxes, Select. Never use native html date pickers, use Shadcn Calendar.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade in and slight upward translation (y: 10 to 0).
motion.hover_states: -translate-y-1 on interactive cards. Image brightness shift on hover.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for gallery photos and invoice rows.

hero_booking.description: Minimalist photography studio setup for the booking landing page hero background.

sample_gallery_1.description: Group of graduates throwing caps, sample photo for client portal gallery.

sample_gallery_2.description: Female graduate portrait, sample photo for client portal gallery.

photographer_avatar.description: Man taking photo using Canon DSLR camera, for photographer profile/avatar.

studio_interior.description: Bright studio with window for contact/location section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Overwrite index.css to include Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
Update tailwind.config.js with the provided color variables for light and dark modes.
Implement Shadcn UI for DatePicker, Dialogs, Tables, Select, Tabs, and Charts.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (e.g., Camera, Calendar, FileText, CheckCircle).
Implement Recharts or Shadcn Charts for Finance Dashboards (Revenue by Month, Expenses).
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing (e.g., data-testid='booking-submit-button').
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Ensure solid backgrounds with appropriate contrast.
Use generous padding (p-8 to p-12) for client-facing pages.
Ensure standard Bahasa Indonesia terminology for all user-facing text based on language_map.
Create a clean masonry layout for the Photo Selection portal, allowing clients to click to toggle selection status (Selected X/20).
Implement Dark/Light mode toggle in the sidebar or header.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY for headers/navs.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
DO NOT center align the App container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭.
